$schema_note: Direct-route topology only (no fares). Researched from Wikipedia airport route tables and route-announcement press coverage, September 2026. Frequencies are rough weekly counts; seasonal routes flagged. ground_minutes on each route is the destination airport-to-city-center transfer time (0-ish for in-town airports), used for the tier A <=60min rule. ground_links is a separate small table of short rail/ground hops between two DIFFERENT cities (both already airport-served), used for the tier B <=3h-ground rule. S5.5: this file is one-time/occasional seed data consumed only by scripts/seed-reach.ts (run by hand, not at Worker runtime) to derive the origins/reachability rows that actually live in D1 -- it is NOT read by the MCP server and is not what refresh_reachability updates. The live, runtime-current route data the get_current_routes MCP tool returns is D1's reachability table (tier + route_note per city_key/origin_iata), which is what a quarterly refresh should diff against; this file only needs hand-regenerating if someone wants to re-run seed-reach.ts's full derivation from scratch. See PROGRESS.md's S5.5 entry.
